ADOPT into @sifu/ui
  • PRIMARY = banked #2B2FBE fill pill (one per view)
  • SECONDARY = outline, hairline border, indigo label, no fill, same 48-52px + pill radius
  • TERTIARY = indigo text + optional chevron, no underline (colour signals tappable)
  • ROW PILL = compact outline (~34px) for in-row actions
  • HIERARCHY: one fill > outline > text, held strict
SKIP · our honest divergence
  • Airbnb’s filled secondary (#88) — a second fill rivals the primary, rejected
  • Airbnb pink / near-black fills + radii — we use #2B2FBE + our pill
  • Underline on standalone tertiary — kept only for inline text-links in body copy
Your eyeball: the four-tier family + the strict hierarchy, and are you good with our deliberate divergence, secondary = outline always (never a second fill), to protect the single indigo? Approve and I bank it; next atom is Icons (element 7), the second-to-last.
